Wrote `/private/var/folders/.../agent/pstack-two/pstack-models.mdc` (the mapped `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc`).

- **Budget: large (xhigh)** — recorded in the `# budget` line and applied to every slug. I probed both models with a `:xhigh` Task call first; both accepted it, so the token was written rather than dropped.
- **Detection:** the only slugs this session exposes are `deepseek/deepseek-flash` and `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`. No claude or grok family slug exists, so there was no same-family substitute to drop in. I mapped by tier rather than collapsing every role to `inherit-parent`: fast tooling roles (feature/refactor, bug-fix, perf, hillclimb, how explorer, why investigators, reflect tooling, swarm workers) → `deepseek-flash`; judgment/prose roles (judgment and prose, hardest tasks, how explainer, why synthesizer, reflect judgment/divergent/synthesizer) → `deepseek-v4-pro`. Panel lists keep both entries, so Arena/architect/interrogate fan-out stays at 2.
- **No prior rule existed**, so nothing was overwritten or dropped as retired, and there were no earlier role changes to preserve.
- Applies to new sessions; re-running `/setup-pstack` rewrites the whole file.

If you'd rather every role just inherit the parent chat model, say so and I'll switch the values. Separately: this workspace is an empty repo with no verification harness — `/create-verification-skill` can generate one whenever you want agents driving the real app for proof.
